2609.05221.title: A Verifier-Guided Explainable Reasoning Framework with Gold-Anchored QLoRA, Task-Aware Mixture-of-Experts, and Group-Relative RLVR
2609.05221.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) show strong reasoning ability, but their explanations can remain inconsistent, weakly grounded, or difficult to verify. We propose a verifier-guided explainable reasoning framework for transparent educational question answering that combines gold-anchored QLoRA, task-aware symbolic routing, and group-relative RLVR. Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct is first adapted with field-weighted QLoRA supervision anchored to authoritative answers. A lightweight router then assigns logic problems to a FOL/Z3 verifier and physics problems to a formula- and unit aware symbolic solver. Verifier feedback is further used to support candidate evaluation, self-revision, and reward construction during RLVR. Candidate responses are evaluated along three complementary dimensions: P1 for answer correctness, P2 for evidence or unit consistency, and P3 for reasoning depth and explainability. At inference, gold-free self-consistency aggregates multiple candidate responses before an optional question-only physics verifier performs conservative system-level correction. On 438 held-out examples, RLVR increases P3 from 50.68% to 72.20%, while hybrid P1 remains approximately stable at 55.94%. Self-consistency improves model only P1 from 48.86% to 50.23%, with symbolic verification providing the remaining hybrid gain. These results indicate that RLVR primarily strengthens explicit reasoning structure, while symbolic verification complements the neural policy by improving answer reliability at the system level.
2609.05221.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）顯示出強大的推理能力，但它們的解釋可能仍然不一致、基礎薄弱或難以驗證。<lb/>我們提出了一個驗證者引導的可解釋推理框架，用於透明的教育問題回答，該框架結合了金標準錨定的QLoRA、任務感知的符號路由和群體相對的RLVR。<lb/>Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct首先經過與權威答案錨定的領域加權QLoRA監督進行調整。<lb/>然後，一個輕量級路由器將邏輯問題分配給FOL/Z3驗證器，並將物理問題分配給一個考慮公式和單位的符號求解器。<lb/>驗證者的反饋進一步用於支持候選評估、自我修正和在RLVR過程中的獎勵構建。<lb/>候選回應沿著三個互補的維度進行評估：P1用於答案正確性，P2用於證據或單位一致性，P3用於推理深度和可解釋性。<lb/>在推理過程中，無金標準的自我一致性在選擇性問題專用的物理驗證器執行保守的系統級修正之前，聚合多個候選回應。<lb/>在438個保留的範例中，RLVR將P3從50.68%提高到72.20%，而混合P1則保持在約55.94%的穩定水平。<lb/>自我一致性將模型的僅P1從48.86%提高到50.23%，符號驗證則提供了剩餘的混合增益。<lb/>這些結果表明，RLVR主要加強了明確的推理結構，而符號驗證則通過改善系統級的答案可靠性來補充神經策略。
